promptBrief: 方向 D「破界信号」：Kotone 从侧栏与主舞台边界探出，连续声波引导至唯一启动 CTA 与紧凑设备控制台。
generationPrompt:
DESKTOP APPLICATION FIRST-SCREEN DESIGN — this must look like a REAL rendered production desktop application screenshot, not a poster, not a marketing landing page, not a loose concept collage.

REFERENCE ROLES:
The FIRST reference image is the current Kotone application first screen. Preserve only the believable Windows desktop proportions, product information architecture, and existing functional vocabulary. Recompose the hierarchy completely.
The SECOND reference image is the Kotone Foundation Sheet. It is the sole identity anchor for the character. Keep the same character identity and cel-shaded rendering language without restating or redesigning her appearance.

Section type: Kotone Tauri/Svelte desktop application home screen, full application canvas at roughly 4:3 proportions.
Design style: “BREAKOUT SIGNAL / 破界信号” — editorial anime fused with a futuristic audio workstation. Visual impact comes from one strong asymmetric composition, character silhouette, typographic scale, and a continuous waveform path; restrained lighting rather than layers of glowing cards.

CONTENT — render as sharp, readable, production-quality UI typography:
A slim custom application utility rail belongs inside the canvas. It contains the brand “Kotone 琴音”, a compact status “● 已停止”, and standard minimize / maximize / close controls.
A narrow left navigation rail contains exactly these labels:
“首页”
“快捷键”
“引擎与模型”
“游戏适配”
“历史记录”
“首页” is active with a fine cyan signal rail and a small concentrated glow.

The main open stage contains:
small eyebrow: “YOUR VOICE, IN THE GAME”
large Chinese headline: “开口，即刻入戏”
brand line: “想说的话，一秒都别等”
support copy: “Kotone 已就绪，让你的声音自然进入每一场游戏。”
one primary action with play icon: “启动 Kotone”
one quiet text action: “运行前检查”

A single compact device console sits beneath the open stage:
label “输入设备”
device “PD200X Podcast Microphone”
a crisp live cyan audio waveform
status chips “本地处理” and “延迟 18 ms”
hotkey “Ctrl + Space”
one small settings chevron.

CHARACTER:
Use the Foundation Sheet reference for identity. Compose Kotone as a knees-up / seven-tenths figure emerging naturally from behind the structural seam between the left navigation rail and the main stage. Her body breaks the rigid rectangular partition and enters the stage; she is part of the layout architecture rather than sitting inside a hero card. Her face and upper body remain clean and prominent. Her right hand cups behind her ear in the single main listening action, her other hand rests naturally and simply. Her hair and jersey hem create an energetic diagonal that leads the eye into the main headline. Navigation labels, the headline, and controls remain unobstructed. The character may overlap decorative background planes and the seam, never live text or interactive controls.

COMPOSITION AND VISUAL FLOW:
Build a clear three-beat reading path: character plus headline first, the single pink primary action second, the live device console third.
Use one continuous cyan waveform signal path that visually begins near the character’s headset, travels through the open stage, passes near the headline and primary action, and resolves into the device waveform below. It is atmospheric and directional, not an extra UI control.
Keep the main stage open and breathable. Use one large editorial headline rather than feature tiles. The device console replaces the previous marketing cards.
The application header, navigation, headline, CTA, and device console align to a believable 8px grid. The design is implementable with normal Svelte, CSS grid/flex, pseudo-elements, masks, and a standalone character cutout.

TEXTURE:
Deep ink-blue surfaces carry extremely low-opacity mechanical keyboard switch cross structures, hollow game-chat bubble contours, and fine waveform traces. Texture is visible mainly in empty space and fades underneath readable UI. Add a single restrained magenta atmospheric bloom behind the character silhouette and a focused cyan rim near the signal path.

COLOR PALETTE:
Deep blue-black #1A1A2E and darker ink tones form the base.
Neon cyan #00E5FF is reserved for audio activity, active navigation, and the waveform path.
Hot magenta #FF2D78 is reserved for the one primary “启动 Kotone” action and a controlled character rim accent.
Electric violet #7B2FFF is used only as a low-intensity atmospheric transition.
Text uses warm white and cool gray at accessible contrast.

VISUAL LANGUAGE:
Award-level editorial anime application UI; crisp Chinese sans-serif typography; a dramatic but usable asymmetric layout; sharp chamfered structural planes around the stage contrasted with one softly rounded device console; thin technical rules; purposeful negative space; restrained glass material; precise spacing; subtle depth.
The character and main typography carry the emotion. UI surfaces stay quiet.
The custom top utility rail is part of the application itself, not external OS mockup chrome.
The main action appears exactly once.
Every label and control looks like live interface content, not baked poster lettering.

Art style: clean cel-shaded + Neon Pop character art consistent with the Foundation Sheet, integrated with a refined dark audio-workstation interface.

CRITICAL RULES:
- This must look like a PIXEL-PERFECT real desktop application render with proper CSS-like layout, grid alignment, and consistent padding
- All listed text must be sharp, readable, and properly typeset with a clear hierarchy
- Preserve the Kotone identity from the Foundation reference
- Integrate the character through the navigation/stage seam; she is never framed as a separate poster card
- Use one dominant primary CTA only
- Use the compact device console as the only lower content block visible in the first screen
- Keep intentional safe space around every live text and interaction zone so the master can be decomposed into L1/L2/L3/L4
- The image fills the canvas edge to edge and is the application screen itself
- OUTPUT MUST LOOK LIKE A REAL APPLICATION SCREENSHOT — not a poster, not an illustration, not a mockup with browser frame
- all text must be sharp, readable, and typeset like real web typography (proper hierarchy: h1 > h2 > body > caption)
- character must be INTEGRATED into the design (emerging from panels, leaning on elements, interacting with UI) — NOT pasted on top or framed
- texture must be SUBTLY woven into backgrounds/cards/borders — not dominant
- include realistic UI elements as appropriate: nav, buttons, cards, icons, dividers, badges
- NO browser chrome, NO mockup label, NO watermark, NO 'design by' credit
- the image fills the canvas edge to edge — it IS the web section

masterpiece, best quality, professional desktop product design, cinematic hierarchy, award-winning UI
notes: Gate 1 改进母版。视觉检查通过：角色身份与 Foundation 一致；人物跨分栏但未遮挡导航和主交互；主 CTA 仅一次；中文主文案和设备信息可读；未出现三张营销卖点卡。生产阶段需要专用 bleed character cutout，并以侧栏/主舞台分界作为接收裁切的 H3/H4 视觉边界。
